checks.name: ruff
checks.command: ruff check and ruff format --check on changed Python files

application_wiring.asr: worker backend inspection requires the shared ASRProvider protocol; backend adapter failures preserve asr stage and explicit kind/code.
application_wiring.diarization: encounter worker requires DiarizationProvider and maps timeout, unavailable and failure to safe diarization codes.
application_wiring.extraction: clinical proposal route requires ExtractionProvider; rule and local-model implementations share it.
application_wiring.drafting: proposal route requires DraftingProvider; timeouts/unavailability return explicit failures without provider fallback.
application_wiring.verification: semantic batch path requires VerificationProvider and preserves verification scope; failures cannot yield approval clearance.

limitations: Clinical extraction and verification share one local-model runtime, although distinct provider interfaces and error stages are enforced.

Native inference operations may not be preemptible; timeout categories are normalized when a runtime raises TimeoutError, while long-running process-level cancellation depends on worker lease checkpoints.
An expanded route-level test subset was not used for acceptance because socket-dependent tests can hang in this Windows environment; the exact focused provider contract suite passed.
